purpose: Index for a defensive technique atlas from low-tech recurring social influence mechanisms through generative-AI manipulation, with explicit anachronism and sacred-text false-positive controls.

historical_caution.primitive_wording_rule: Use LOW_TECH_RECURRING_SOCIAL_MECHANISMS, not a claimed reconstruction of prehistoric propaganda.
historical_caution.anachronism_rule: Modern categories may not be projected onto ancient texts without supported institutional and technological context.
historical_caution.genre_rule: Prayer, hymn, law, lament, epic, treaty, wisdom, liturgy, myth, royal inscription, polemic, satire and historiography require different base-rate controls.
historical_caution.intent_rule: Intent and audience effect are separate evidence gates.

sacred_text_screening_ladder.meaning: Form plus plausible pressure/asymmetry; alternative genre explanations remain open.
Institutional/collective persuasive purpose and audience direction are supported.
Multiple context signals support strategic manipulation, concealment, coercive asymmetry or systematic distortion.
Independent evidence supports actual audience belief/behavior effect; reach/repetition alone is insufficient.

base_rate_controls: epic/poetry/ritual text of same culture and period
competing sectarian text where provenance permits
shared textual ancestry and translation dependence collapsed before recurrence counting
next_gate: Run false-positive calibration on non-sacred genre-matched controls before interpreting sacred texts.
